Name: Sloppy Underwear Zap
Author: Kupok
Description:
This simply renders the default underpants and undershirt for both girl and boy farmers transparent. The default farmer base looks something like a barrel ken doll, so this is best used with other mods that alters the base farmer.

Bikini/Swim/Bath House clothing is tied to your current pants. If you're wearing pants, you'll have swimwear. If you are not wearing pants, the swimwear will also disappear.

This overwrites Farmer shirts and pants, so it might not play nicely with other mods that totally replace farmer shirts and pants.

Downloads.Description: Would you believe this is the first thing I uploaded to Nexus?
